lines.zh: 我摆尾，水面上漾开一圈蓝色。
lines.en: One flick of my tail rings the surface blue.

lines.zh: 我只在水里游，上岸就动不了。
lines.en: I swim only in water; on land I cannot move.

lines.zh: 我绕着水草转，蓝鳞在闪。
lines.en: I circle the pondweed, blue scales flashing.

lines.zh: 我贴着河床游，沙粒从鳃边过。
lines.en: I skim the riverbed as sand grains pass my gills.

lines.zh: 浅水让我安心，深水让我害怕。
lines.en: Shallows calm me; deep water frightens me.

lines.zh: 我顺流而下，比逆流省力。
lines.en: I swim downstream; it costs less than fighting the current.

lines.zh: 我的鳍太小，游起来有点晃。
lines.en: My fins are small, so I wobble as I swim.

lines.zh: 我在石缝间穿来穿去，像一枚硬币。
lines.en: I thread the gaps between stones like a coin.

lines.zh: 水面有影子，我就往下沉。
lines.en: A shadow crosses the surface, and I sink.

lines.zh: 我游得很慢，蓝光却很快。
lines.en: I swim slowly, but the blue gleam travels fast.

lines.zh: 我转个弯，鳞片把光甩出去。
lines.en: I turn, and my scales fling the light away.

lines.zh: 我跟着鱼群，其实只是跟着水。
lines.en: I follow the school, though really I follow the water.

lines.zh: 我的蓝鳞在后头拖出一条细光。
lines.en: My blue scales trail a thin gleam behind me.

lines.zh: 别划水，你的桨声吓到我了。
lines.en: Stop paddling; your oars frighten me.

lines.zh: 我贴着石壁游，鳞光很淡。
lines.en: I hug the stone wall, my scales faint.

lines.zh: 水底的蓝光跟着我走。
lines.en: The blue glow on the bottom follows me.

lines.zh: 我停在水草里，假装是块石头。
lines.en: I rest in the weeds and pretend to be a stone.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，等小虫漂过来。
lines.en: I hold my mouth open, waiting for insects to drift in.

lines.zh: 我的蓝鳞在水底很显眼，真糟糕。
lines.en: My blue scales stand out on the bottom. Bad luck.

lines.zh: 一个泡从我嘴里升起，碰到水面就破。
lines.en: A bubble rises from my mouth and pops at the surface.

lines.zh: 水很凉，我的鳞片贴着不动。
lines.en: The water is cold, and my scales lie still.

lines.zh: 我靠在石头上，鳃还在轻轻开合。
lines.en: I lean on a stone, gills opening and closing softly.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像一块蓝宝石。
lines.en: I stay perfectly still, like a sapphire.

lines.zh: 水面上的光晃来晃去，我看久了会晕。
lines.en: Light shifts on the surface until I feel dizzy.

lines.zh: 我听见岸上有脚步声，就沉下去。
lines.en: Footsteps on the bank, and I sink.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴慢慢摆，其实没在游。
lines.en: My tail sways slowly, though I am not swimming.

lines.zh: 水草拂过我的背，有点痒。
lines.en: The weeds brush my back, and it tickles.

lines.zh: 我把身体埋进沙里，只露出眼。
lines.en: I bury myself in sand, leaving only my eyes out.

lines.zh: 我数水面的涟漪，数到七就忘了。
lines.en: I count ripples and lose the count at seven.

lines.zh: 没有声音时，我和河床一个颜色。
lines.en: With no sound, I match the riverbed exactly.

lines.zh: 你蹲在岸边，我看见你的倒影。
lines.en: You crouch on the bank, and I see your reflection.

lines.zh: 你的手伸进水里，我退到石下。
lines.en: Your hand enters the water, and I slip under a stone.

lines.zh: 我隔着水面看你，你变得很大。
lines.en: I watch you through the surface, and you look huge.

lines.zh: 你挡住阳光，我的浅滩就黑了。
lines.en: You block the sun, and my shallows go dark.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手指，那像虫子。
lines.en: I stare at your fingers; they look like worms.

lines.zh: 你别敲水面，我耳朵疼。
lines.en: Do not tap the surface; it hurts my ears.

lines.zh: 我探出头看你一眼，又缩回去。
lines.en: I poke my head out for a look, then duck back.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛在找我，我屏住鳃。
lines.en: Your eyes search for me, and I hold my gills still.

lines.zh: 你看很久才发现水里有蓝光。
lines.en: You look a long while before spotting the blue below.

lines.zh: 你在笑，我不懂那是什么意思。
lines.en: You are smiling, and I do not know what it means.

lines.zh: 你碰我一下，我掉了一片鳞。
lines.en: One touch, and I lose a scale.

lines.zh: 疼，我只有两颗心可以撑。
lines.en: It hurts, and I have only two hearts to spare.

lines.zh: 我翻了个身，鳃还在动。
lines.en: I flip over, gills still moving.

lines.zh: 这一下让我窜出去老远。
lines.en: That blow sends me darting far away.

lines.zh: 我的蓝鳞被你刮花了。
lines.en: You scratched the blue off my scales.

lines.zh: 血流进水里，散得很快。
lines.en: Blood spreads quickly through the water.

lines.zh: 别再来一下，我会死。
lines.en: Not another; I will die.

lines.zh: 我躲进石缝，尾巴还在抖。
lines.en: I hide in a crack, tail still trembling.

lines.zh: 这一击让我记一辈子，虽然很短。
lines.en: I will remember that blow my whole short life.

lines.zh: 红色从我身下散开，越散越淡。
lines.en: Red spreads from beneath me, thinning as it goes.

lines.zh: 你撒下的饵，闻起来像虾。
lines.en: What you scattered smells like shrimp.

lines.zh: 我不该过来，可那味道太近。
lines.en: I should not come closer, but the smell is near.

lines.zh: 你在水里晃手指，我就跟着晃。
lines.en: You wiggle a finger in the water, and I follow it.

lines.zh: 我绕着饵转，还没决定。
lines.en: I circle the bait, still undecided.

lines.zh: 为这一小口，我要不要靠近？
lines.en: For one small bite, should I come closer?

lines.zh: 你把面包屑按进水里，我饿了。
lines.en: You press breadcrumbs under, and I am hungry.

lines.zh: 我张嘴又合上，怕里面是钩。
lines.en: I open my mouth, then close it, fearing a hook.

lines.zh: 香味从上游来，我逆流游过去。
lines.en: The scent comes from upstream, and I swim against it.

lines.zh: 别动，让我再看一眼。
lines.en: Hold still and let me look once more.

lines.zh: 我咬了，你的手真快。
lines.en: I bit, and your hand was very quick.

lines.zh: 你碰到我，我的鳞全竖起来。
lines.en: You touch me, and every scale stands up.

lines.zh: 我被水流推着撞上石头。
lines.en: The current shoves me into a stone.

lines.zh: 别抓我，我的鳞会掉。
lines.en: Do not grab me; my scales come off.

lines.zh: 我们擦身而过，水面碎了一下。
lines.en: We brush past, and the surface breaks apart.

lines.zh: 你踩进水里，把我挤到一边。
lines.en: You step into the water and push me aside.

lines.zh: 我撞到你的靴子，赶紧转身。
lines.en: I hit your boot and turn away fast.

lines.zh: 碰撞让我的蓝光闪了一下。
lines.en: The bump makes my blue flash once.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的腿游过，你没感觉。
lines.en: I glide past your leg and you never feel it.

lines.zh: 轻一点，我只有两颗心那么脆。
lines.en: Careful; I am as fragile as two hearts.

lines.zh: 我被你撞得肚皮朝上，扑腾了两下。
lines.en: You knock me belly-up, and I flop twice.

lines.zh: 两条蓝影在水草里绕圈。
lines.en: Two blue shapes circle in the weeds.

lines.zh: 我找个同伴，一起守着这片浅滩。
lines.en: I seek a companion to guard this shallows with me.

lines.zh: 我们把卵藏在石头底下。
lines.en: We hide our eggs beneath a stone.

lines.zh: 它游过来，我的鳞亮得更蓝。
lines.en: It swims near, and my scales turn a deeper blue.

lines.zh: 配对的时候，我们谁也不说话。
lines.en: When we pair, neither of us speaks.

lines.zh: 这条河里，像我的鱼不多了。
lines.en: Few fish like me remain in this river.

lines.zh: 我跟着它，游了一整个下午。
lines.en: I followed it all afternoon.

lines.zh: 春天水暖，我就想找伴。
lines.en: When spring warms the water, I want company.

lines.zh: 它走了，我还在原地等。
lines.en: It left, and I am still waiting here.

lines.zh: 我们的蓝在水底连成一片。
lines.en: Our blues join into one patch on the riverbed.

lines.zh: 我不捡东西，我的嘴只会吞。
lines.en: I do not pick things up; my mouth only swallows.

lines.zh: 那块亮片漂过来，我绕开了。
lines.en: A bright flake drifts by, and I swim around it.

lines.zh: 我试着叼起它，又掉了。
lines.en: I try to carry it and drop it again.

lines.zh: 水底的硬币？我以为是鱼鳞。
lines.en: A coin on the bottom? I took it for a scale.

lines.zh: 我把它吞了，味道不对。
lines.en: I swallowed it, and the taste was wrong.

lines.zh: 我推着它走，像推一颗小石头。
lines.en: I nudge it along like a small pebble.

lines.zh: 你扔进水里的东西，都会沉到我这儿。
lines.en: Whatever you throw in sinks down to me.

lines.zh: 我不需要带什么，水里什么都有。
lines.en: I need to carry nothing; the water provides.

lines.zh: 它卡在我鳃里，我甩了很久。
lines.en: It stuck in my gill, and I shook for a long time.

lines.zh: 我把它藏在水草下，明天再来。
lines.en: I tuck it under the weeds and will return tomorrow.

lines.zh: 水动了一下，我抬头看。
lines.en: The water moved, and I look up.

lines.zh: 有东西在岸边，不是鱼。
lines.en: Something is on the bank, and it is not a fish.

lines.zh: 我闻到饵味，也闻到铁味。
lines.en: I smell bait, and I smell iron.

lines.zh: 你站在浅水里，我绕着你。
lines.en: You stand in the shallows, and I circle you.

lines.zh: 我盯上你的影子，不是你的脸。
lines.en: I fix on your shadow, not your face.

lines.zh: 那片水草里有动静，我去看看。
lines.en: Something stirs in the weeds; I will look.

lines.zh: 你落水了，我不知道该怕还是该近。
lines.en: You fell in, and I cannot decide whether to flee or approach.

lines.zh: 我锁定水面上的那点红。
lines.en: I lock onto that fleck of red on the surface.

lines.zh: 你伸手进来，我看见了。
lines.en: Your hand comes in, and I see it.

lines.zh: 我跟着水波，找到了你。
lines.en: I followed the ripples and found you.

lines.zh: 我悬在你手边，等它停下来。
lines.en: I hover by your hand, waiting for it to stop.

lines.zh: 你的手停在水里，我停在石头边。
lines.en: Your hand stops in the water; I stop by the stone.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在两侧，你抓不准。
lines.en: My eyes sit on both sides; you cannot aim true.

lines.zh: 我绕半圈，从你背后看。
lines.en: I swing half around to watch from behind you.

lines.zh: 水面反光，你找不到我。
lines.en: The surface glares, and you cannot find me.

lines.zh: 我贴近了，你的手指动了一下。
lines.en: I come close, and your finger twitches.

lines.zh: 再等一秒，我就咬。
lines.en: One more second, and I bite.

lines.zh: 我盯着饵，也盯着你的手腕。
lines.en: I watch the bait, and I watch your wrist.

lines.zh: 你退半步，水就浑了。
lines.en: You step back, and the water clouds.

lines.zh: 这个距离，我随时能跑。
lines.en: At this distance I can bolt any time.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口，是钩子。
lines.en: I bit down, and it was a hook.

lines.zh: 我撞你的手，只想让你松开。
lines.en: I butt your hand, only wanting you to let go.

lines.zh: 我的牙很小，咬不穿皮。
lines.en: My teeth are small and will not pierce skin.

lines.zh: 你一抓，我的尾巴甩了你一脸水。
lines.en: You grab, and my tail throws water in your face.

lines.zh: 我挣得很厉害，鳞掉了几片。
lines.en: I thrash hard and lose a few scales.

lines.zh: 别捏我，我会咬你的指头。
lines.en: Do not squeeze me; I will bite your finger.

lines.zh: 这一下不算攻击，是害怕。
lines.en: That was not an attack; that was fear.

lines.zh: 我从你手里滑出去，摔回水里。
lines.en: I slip from your hand and fall back into the water.

lines.zh: 我拍水，水花溅到你眼睛。
lines.en: I slap the water, and the spray hits your eyes.

lines.zh: 咬完我就跑，从不回头看。
lines.en: I bite and flee, never looking back.

lines.zh: 水里多了一小团蓝，那就是我。
lines.en: A small blue shape appears in the water, and it is me.

lines.zh: 我从卵里出来，第一眼是水草。
lines.en: I left the egg, and the first thing I saw was weeds.

lines.zh: 河湾很浅，我在这里长大。
lines.en: The bend is shallow, and I grew up here.

lines.zh: 雨季来了，我被冲进这条河。
lines.en: The rains came and washed me into this river.

lines.zh: 我从石头底下游出来，鳞还没亮。
lines.en: I swim out from under a stone, scales not yet bright.

lines.zh: 水面破开，我摆尾沉下去。
lines.en: The surface breaks, and I flick my tail down.

lines.zh: 这片浅滩一直有我这样的鱼。
lines.en: This shallows has always held fish like me.

lines.zh: 我出生时，蓝鳞只有一点点。
lines.en: When I was born, I had only a trace of blue.

lines.zh: 溪水把我带到这儿，我就留下了。
lines.en: The stream brought me here, and I stayed.

lines.zh: 你看见的那点蓝光，是我。
lines.en: That blue glimmer you saw was me.

lines.zh: 水面上有火，我往最深处钻。
lines.en: Fire on the surface, and I dive as deep as I can.

lines.zh: 我被甩出水面，摔在岸上扑腾。
lines.en: Flung from the water, I flop on the bank.

lines.zh: 水太浑，我的鳃堵住了。
lines.en: The water is too thick, and my gills clog.

lines.zh: 水被炸开，我在半空翻了个圈。
lines.en: The water bursts, and I tumble through the air.

lines.zh: 箭射进水里，擦过我的背。
lines.en: An arrow enters the water and grazes my back.

lines.zh: 药水让水变苦，我的鳞发麻。
lines.en: Potion sours the water, and my scales go numb.

lines.zh: 水里没有小虫，我越来越瘦。
lines.en: No insects in the water, and I grow thin.

lines.zh: 雷顺着水过来，我的鳍僵住了。
lines.en: Lightning runs through the water and stiffens my fins.

lines.zh: 周围没有水，我只能一直坠落。
lines.en: No water around me; I can only keep falling.
